tagline.en_US: Runs Proxmox Datacenter Manager as a native LXC to see and manage several Proxmox VE nodes and clusters from one place, including migrations between them. Community packaging by Dockur, not an official Proxmox image.

description.en_US: Proxmox Datacenter Manager is a centralized management platform for Proxmox VE nodes and clusters. It provides a web interface featuring a global dashboard to monitor node health and resource utilization. The application aggregates task logs across your infrastructure, tracks available updates and security patches, and supports cross-cluster migration of virtual guests.
